title: Sparse stochastic Mirror posterior vs rank-1 BNN
hypothesis: For a binary prediction task whose exact posterior has two weight modes differing on one sparse direction, a one-scalar Mirror view code over a shared mean/direction will preserve posterior predictive NLL and calibration while compressing the two-model posterior. A rank-1 multiplicative Bayesian neural network is the required strong uncertainty control; a direct sparse scalar code determines whether the effect is Mirror-specific.
physical_object: one shared 32-dimensional linear classifier mean weight and one sparse functional uncertainty direction
mirror_coordinate: categorical scalar m in {-1,+1} selecting one of two posterior weight realizations
logical_multiplicity: two stochastic posterior functions with prior probability 0.5 each
controls: two independent full posterior weight vectors
rank-1 multiplicative BNN posterior with shared scalar stochastic factor
Mirror sparse direction plus stochastic scalar code

development.selection_metric: predictive NLL, Brier, ECE, probability calibration error, actual posterior payload bytes, sample MACs

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP32 inference posterior payload bytes after reload

success_gate: All fresh worlds: Mirror predictive NLL within 0.01 of exact two-mode posterior, ECE <=0.02, probability calibration MSE <=1e-4, and payload at least 20% below both independent full weights and rank-1 BNN posterior at equal quality. Enumerate both posterior modes exactly and report the two-component compute.
failure_gate: Mirror misses NLL/calibration thresholds in at least two fresh worlds; or rank-1 BNN/direct sparse code is within 10% bytes and equal quality; or posterior sampling compute exceeds 2x rank-1 BNN.
development_decision: In both development worlds, Mirror had exact teacher calibration but was 1,196B, larger than the independent two-weight posterior at 651-652B, and one byte larger than the rank-1 BNN at equal quality. Freeze FAIL for the storage hypothesis and keep fresh seeds sealed. A code audit found that prediction enumerates the two discrete modes exactly rather than sampling 64 draws; report two exact components and amend the compute description accordingly.
amendment: Before fresh access, correct posterior compute reporting to exact enumeration of both discrete modes. No model, quality result, storage threshold, or seed changed. Fresh seeds 34911–34913 remain sealed after the development fail gate.
boundaries: analytic synthetic Bayesian logistic model, no learned posterior or variational optimization
true posterior is a planted two-mode distribution known to all methods
sparse uncertainty direction is oracle supplied
posterior calibration does not establish task learning, ensemble capacity, or natural-language uncertainty
